import pytest
from api import submit
from queueing import payload
from worker import execute

# Test api.submit with region parameter
def test_api_submit_region():
    enqueue_called = []
    def mock_enqueue(p):
        enqueue_called.append(p)
    
    submit("test_owner", mock_enqueue, region="worldwide")
    assert enqueue_called[0]["region"] == "worldwide"

# Test api.submit with invalid region
def test_api_submit_invalid_region():
    try:
        submit("test_owner", lambda p: None, region="invalid")
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Test queueing.payload with region parameter
def test_payload_region():
    result = payload("test_owner", region="europe")
    assert result["region"] == "europe"

# Test worker.execute with region parameter
def test_execute_region():
    result = execute({"owner": "test", "region": "americas"}, lambda o, r: r, region="worldwide")
    assert result == "americas"

# Test legacy queue records without region (should default to worldwide)
def test_legacy_records():
    result = execute({"owner": "test"}, lambda o, r: r, region="worldwide")
    assert result == "worldwide"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
